# Vendored libraries

Unmodified subsets of these open-source libraries, with their own test suites, are used by the `pyrepo` family. Bugs are injected only into per-episode copies, never into these files.

| library | version | license |
|---|---|---|
| toolz | 1.2.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`toolz/LICENSE`) |
| boltons | 26.2.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`boltons/LICENSE`) |
| tabulate | 0.10.0 | MIT (`tabulate/LICENSE`) |
| inflection | 0.5.1 | MIT (`inflection/LICENSE`) |
